collekt ships a **source-adapter** for each supported provider. An adapter knows
how to fetch source-native files for a request and how to plan (dry-run) the same
work. Adapters are registered on import (`collekt.sources`) and selected by a
source's `kind`.

## Built-in adapters

| Kind | Produces | Access | Format |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cmems` | Gridded ocean fields (currents, SST, waves, biogeochemistry) | open | NetCDF |
| `ecmwf_open_data` | Gridded forecast wind | open | GRIB2 |
| `era5` | Gridded reanalysis wind | credentials (CDS) | NetCDF |
| `copernicus_dataspace` | Sentinel / Landsat product files | credentials | product (e.g. `.zip`) |
| `skytruth` | Oil-slick detections (features) | open | Parquet |
| `hozint` | Threat-intelligence reports (features) | credentials | Parquet |
| `eodyn` | eOdyn surface currents / drifters | credentials | NetCDF |

Open sources need no secrets; credential-gated sources resolve their secrets from
the environment or provider tools — see [Credentials](credentials.qmd). The eOdyn
adapter serves a historical preview archive (`mode: archive`) until the
production API ships (`mode: api`).

## Configuring sources

collekt provides the adapters and the configuration *mechanism*; the concrete
**catalog** (which datasets and variables each source pulls) and any curated
**presets** are supplied by the caller through a configuration directory:

```bash
collekt fetch --bbox -6 20 35 45 --start 2023-06-15 \
  --variables currents --conf-dir path/to/catalogs --preset drift
```

A configuration directory contains a `default.yaml`, an optional `source/` folder
of catalogs referenced by `source_catalogs`, and an optional `preset/` folder.
A source entry looks like:

```yaml
sources:
  cmems_glorys:
    kind: cmems
    variable_groups: [currents]
    path: "cmems/glorys"
    filename_pattern: "glorys_{dataset_id}_{date:%Y%m%d}_{bbox_hash}.nc"
    dataset_nrt: "cmems_mod_glo_phy-cur_anfc_0.083deg_P1D-m"
    dataset_my: "cmems_mod_glo_phy_my_0.083deg_P1D-m"
    nrt_cutoff: "2024-07-01"
    variables:
      default: [uo, vo]
    temporal:
      native_sampling: 24h
      supported_sampling: [24h]
    depth: [1.0, 1.1]
```

The broad **variable-group vocabulary** (what `currents`/`wind`/`waves` select)
and curated presets are domain concerns and live with the consuming brick, not in
collekt. A request's `variables` are matched generically against each source's
`variable_groups`.

## Dependencies

collekt installs all provider clients and the gridded `Assembler` by default, so
every source works out of the box after `uv sync`. Clients are imported lazily,
so importing collekt stays fast and a source only pulls its client into memory
when it actually runs. The ECMWF Open Data forecast subset and Skytruth need no
credentials; the other providers do — see [Credentials](credentials.qmd).
